top_signals.title: The Military Strategic Drivers Behind China’s Nuclear Expansion
top_signals.summary:
In June 1993, a group of Second Artillery Corps senior leaders gathered at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The organizers brought Li Xuge, recently retired commander of the Second Artillery, as a special guest for the event. Li had watched the Second Artillery develop from its infancy to this day, when China finally tested a ballistic missile capable of striking anywhere within the United States. However, Li had received significant pushback on the program in the years prior to this launch.  In the early 1990s, China’s military strategy was shifting to focus on war with Taiwan. top_signals.title: UK Inflation Accelerates to Highest Level in a Year
top_signals.summary: Consumer prices rose 3.6% from a year earlier after a surge in energy bills and motor fuel costs, the Office for National Statistics said on Wednesday. It was in line with economists’ expectations. Bloomberg's Sam Unsted breaks down the numbers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
